content: {"praised":["Simple, emotionally resonant story about confronting mortality.","Masterpiece that defies typical epic Kurosawa style.","Retrospective life film akin to Citizen Kane, Wild Strawberries.","Deep thematic exploration of purpose and legacy.","Powerful character development, especially of the protagonist."],"criticized":["Tedious, slow pacing makes film feel too long.","Poorly written dialogue, unsympathetic main character.","Overacted performances reduce authenticity.","Brief roles for sympathetic characters feel underdeveloped.","Subtitles may hinder understanding of dialogue."]}
